brand.name: Bracket
brand.promise: Designers don't need more tools. They need better decisions.

choreography.hover_micro_interaction: Scale to 0.98 on press, border color shifts to hairline_hover, slight bg brighten. 150ms ease-out.

component_refinements.card-brut: Rename/Refine to `.card-linear`: bg-surface_1, border border-hairline, rounded-lg, overflow-hidden, no box-shadow.
component_refinements.liquid-glass: Refine to `.glass-panel`: bg-[#000000]/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-hairline.
component_refinements.btn-brut: Refine to `.btn-primary`: bg-accent_primary text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium text-[13px] transition-all hover:brightness-110 active:scale-[0.98] shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.2)]
component_refinements.btn-ghost: Refine to `.btn-ghost`: bg-transparent text-text_secondary hover:text-text_primary hover:bg-surface_2 rounded-md transition-all active:scale-[0.98]
component_refinements.input-line: Refine to `.input-linear`: bg-surface_1 border border-hairline rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-[14px] text-text_primary focus:border-accent_primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent_primary/30 outline-none transition-all
component_refinements.textarea-brut: Refine to `.textarea-linear`: same as input-linear but min-h-[120px] resize-none leading-relaxed
component_refinements.suggest-chip: Refine to `.suggest-chip`: border border-hairline bg-surface_1 text-text_secondary text-[12px] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-surface_2 hover:text-text_primary cursor-pointer transition-all
component_refinements.status-pill: Refine to `.status-pill`: flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] font-medium px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-hairline bg-surface_1.
component_refinements.icon-tile: Refine to `.icon-tile`: w-8 h-8 rounded-md bg-surface_2 border border-hairline flex items-center justify-center text-text_secondary
component_refinements.app-shell: Sidebar 240px expanded / 64px collapsed. bg-background. border-r border-hairline. Content area bg-surface_1 (slightly lifted from pure black).
component_refinements.nav-item: text-[13px] font-medium text-text_secondary hover:text-text_primary hover:bg-surface_2 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors
component_refinements.step-pipeline: flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar py-4 border-b border-hairline. Nodes are 24px circles, connected by 1px hairline lines. Active step gets border-accent_primary.

page_blueprints.Marketing_Header: Fixed top, w-full, z-50, `.glass-panel`. Left: {B} Bracket. Right: Ghost button (Login), Primary button (Get Started). Height: 60px.

Landing_Page.Hero: Centered. Ambient mesh gradient background behind hero (subtle). H1 (text-5xl), Subtitle (text-lg text-text_secondary max-w-2xl). CTA group. Staggered fade-up entry.
Landing_Page.Problem_Walkthrough: Bento-box grid structure. Cards with `border-hairline`. Asymmetric layout.
Landing_Page.Social_Proof: Mono logos at 40% opacity, hover to 100%. Single row marquee or grid.
Landing_Page.Pricing: 3-column grid. Middle card has 1px solid accent_primary border and subtle accent_glow. Features listed with 14px text and crisp check icons.

page_blueprints.Auth: Centered card (max-w-md), bg-surface_1, border-hairline. Clean typography. Minimalist input-linear. 'Back to home' ghost link.
page_blueprints.App_Dashboard: Top header: Breadcrumb or Greeting. Action bar: 'New Project' button right-aligned. Grid of projects (card-linear). Empty state: subtle dashed border, ghost icon, clear CTA.
page_blueprints.Project_Flow: Left Pane (60%): Textarea, AI suggestion chips below it. Right Pane (40%): Live artifact preview in a sticky card. Top: Step pipeline indicator '{ 01 / 05 }'. Ambient pulse when AI is generating.
page_blueprints.Project_Document: Centered, max-w-3xl. Pure white or #F7F7F8 text. Looks like a pristine, locked, high-end document. Read-only. Action bar floating at bottom for Export/Share.
page_blueprints.Client_Review: Similar to Project Document but wrapped in a 'Review Mode' shell. Fixed bottom bar with 'Approve' (Primary, Green/Accent) and 'Request Changes' (Ghost/Danger) buttons.

what_to_remove: Shouty all-caps display headings - replace with sentence case, tight-tracking Inter.
Brutalist `{ first project }` chrome - replace with clean `.card-linear` borders.
Giant gradient-text 'yet.' pop - replace with subtle, solid white or brand-accent text highlights.
Mono `{ 01 / 05 }` over-use - restrict to the active step indicator only, make it 11px and muted.
Oversized drop shadows - use hairline borders and surface color differentiation instead.
Thick dark mode borders (e.g., 2px+) - everything must be 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08).
hero_ambient_art_direction: Linear-style subtle ambience. Use a CSS-only radial gradient overlay placed absolutely behind the hero text. `background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(124, 92, 255, 0.15), transparent 50%);` paired with a very faint absolute SVG grid (`opacity-10`, `stroke-hairline`, 1px stroke-width, 32px cell size). NO 'AI' glowing brains, NO complex 3D renders. Just geometric, ultra-clean light emission.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-btn'`).
testing_and_accessibility.focus_rings: Keyboard navigation must show `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent_primary/50 focus:outline-none`. Do NOT use default blue outlines.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Text-secondary must remain legible (minimum `#A0A0AB` on `#000000` gives ~4.5:1).
testing_and_accessibility.file_extensions: Guideline is tailored strictly for `.js` environments (React 19 + Tailwind). Avoid `.tsx` patterns.

pixel_checklist: Are there any accidental default box-shadows? (Must be removed)
Are button hit areas at least 40x40px on mobile, despite visual height?
Is the body text exactly 14px (or 13px for dense UI) with `leading-relaxed`?
Do all hover states transition smoothly (150ms ease-out)?
Is the spacing rhythm mathematically consistent (multiples of 4px)?
Do all pages implement the `page_enter` fade/blur stagger?
